source_caption:
🎬 Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)

Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle follows two best friends, Harold Lee and Kumar Patel, whose simple late-night craving for fast food turns into one of the most ridiculous adventures of their lives. Harold is a hardworking investment banker who struggles to stand up for himself, while Kumar is a carefree medical school candidate who prefers having fun over taking responsibility. After watching a commercial for White Castle burgers, the two decide to satisfy their hunger with a quick trip to the restaurant. However, what should have been an ordinary drive quickly spirals into complete chaos as they encounter bizarre strangers, unexpected obstacles, outrageous misunderstandings, and hilarious situations that constantly delay their journey. Along the way, they cross paths with a wild version of Neil Patrick Harris, face trouble with the police, and discover that even the simplest goals can lead to unforgettable experiences. Starring John Cho, Kal Penn, Neil Patrick Harris, and Paula Garcés, the film delivers outrageous comedy, memorable characters, and an entertaining story about friendship, freedom, confidence, and enjoying life’s unexpected adventures.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Adventure • Buddy Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 28m • R

🎥 Director: Danny Leiner

✍️ Writers: Jon Hurwitz & Hayden Schlossberg

📚 Setting: New Jersey, following Harold and Kumar’s unforgettable late-night journey to White Castle.

🎬 Film Series: The first installment in the Harold & Kumar trilogy.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (released in some international markets as Harold & Kumar Get the Munchies) is a 2004 American buddy stoner comedy film directed by Danny Leiner, written by Jon Hurwitz and Hayden Schlossberg, and starring John Cho, Kal Penn, Neil Patrick Harris, Anthony Anderson and Fred Willard. The first installment in the Harold & Kumar franchise, the film follows Harold Lee (Cho) and Kumar Patel (Penn) on their adventure to a White Castle restaurant after smoking marijuana. Hurwitz and Schlossberg developed Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle based on experiences and people from when they attended Randolph High School.
